title: 灰烬新庭

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：单只白鹿位于下中并向右迈步，炭门高处留空，左枯右荣与低处旧头骨清楚，冷却黑土地面连续到底；未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Death tarot master, theme 灰烬新庭 / New Court from Ashes. Show peaceful renewal after cooling, with no active fire, disaster, violence, or gore.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolism, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE elegant white stag with large natural antlers, positioned in the LOWER CENTER and walking credibly toward the RIGHT. All hooves relate naturally to the ground; no other deer or living animals.
Scene/backdrop: a tall charcoal stone arch rises overhead with generous empty space inside and above it. The LEFT side is dormant with dry dark branches and cool gray ash; the RIGHT side is alive with distinct fresh green seedlings rising from cooled black soil. Include exactly ONE small old weathered animal skull low on the dormant left side, subdued, partially embedded in earth.
Composition/framing: stag lower center stepping right, charcoal arch high, seedlings concentrated on right. Cooled continuous black earth, scattered gray leaves, and the stag's hoof contact extend as one substantial ground plane to the bottom bleed. Fine charcoal-texture and new-leaf-foil tarot border.
Style/medium: high-detail hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, elegant symbolic realism, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: aftermath, release, patient renewal, quiet dawn.
Color palette: charcoal gray, luminous white, fresh blue-green, restrained silver and pale gold.
Constraints: exactly one white stag and one subtle skull; clear left-dormant/right-renewing split; black ground is cool with no flames or smoke disaster; believable walking gait and contact.
Avoid: extra deer, ghost animals, living animal emerging from skull, people, skeleton figure, blood, gore, active fire, burning forest, disaster, battle, floating hooves, thin floating pedestal, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
